reproduction.procedure_source:
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import random
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "docs/validation/vst3-callback-benchmark-20261123.json"
SCRATCH = ROOT / "build/a069"
BINARY = ROOT / "build/vst3/rhodes_vst3_benchmark"
SOURCE_COMMIT = "301558122aa8e61100dc6857555789e8c5b887a9"
SDK = ROOT.parent / "vst3sdk"


def stamp() -> str:
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def command(argv: list[str], cwd: Path = ROOT) -> dict:
    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"argv": argv, "exit_code": p.returncode,
            "stdout": p.stdout, "stderr": p.stderr}


def read_optional(path: Path):
    try:
        return path.read_text().strip()
    except OSError:
        return None


SOURCES = [
    "apps/vst3_benchmark.cpp", "src/research_engine.cpp",
    "include/rhodes/research_engine.hpp", "include/rhodes/event_processor.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/note_tracker.hpp", "include/rhodes/instrument_state.hpp",
    "include/rhodes/control_value.hpp", "plugins/vst3/processor.cpp",
    "plugins/vst3/processor.hpp", "plugins/vst3/state_stream.cpp",
    "plugins/vst3/state_stream.hpp", "plugins/vst3/plugin_ids.hpp",
]
ARCHIVES = ["build/vst3/librhodes_core.a"] + [
    f"build/vst3/lib/Release/lib{name}.a"
    for name in ("sdk", "sdk_common", "base", "pluginterfaces")]
BUILD_FILES = [
    "build/vst3/CMakeFiles/rhodes_vst3_benchmark.dir/flags.make",
    "build/vst3/CMakeFiles/rhodes_vst3_benchmark.dir/link.txt",
    "build/vst3/CMakeFiles/rhodes_core.dir/flags.make",
    "build/vst3/CMakeFiles/rhodes_core.dir/link.txt",
]
for target in ("sdk", "sdk_common", "base", "pluginterfaces"):
    BUILD_FILES += [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in
                    (ROOT / "build/vst3").rglob(f"{target}.dir/flags.make")]

bound_paths = SOURCES + ARCHIVES + BUILD_FILES + [str(BINARY.relative_to(ROOT))]
before = {p: digest(ROOT / p) for p in bound_paths}
source_matches = {}
for p in SOURCES:
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{SOURCE_COMMIT}:{p}"], cwd=ROOT)
    source_matches[p] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == before[p]
assert all(source_matches.values()), source_matches

pins = {}
for component in (".", "base", "cmake", "pluginterfaces", "public.sdk"):
    path = SDK / component
    revision = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=path,
                                       text=True).strip()
    clean = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "--ignore-submodules=all",
                            "HEAD", "--"], cwd=path, check=False).returncode == 0
    pins[component] = {"revision": revision, "tracked_clean": clean}

affinity = sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) if hasattr(os, "sched_getaffinity") else None
cpuinfo = read_optional(Path("/proc/cpuinfo"))
models = sorted({line.split(":", 1)[1].strip() for line in (cpuinfo or "").splitlines()
                 if line.startswith("model name")})
first_cpu = affinity[0] if affinity else 0
environment = {
    "platform": platform.platform(), "uname": dict(platform.uname()._asdict()),
    "python": platform.python_version(), "libc": platform.libc_ver(),
    "visible_cpu_models": models, "os_cpu_count": os.cpu_count(),
    "observed_process_affinity_cpus": affinity,
    "affinity_changed_by_experiment": False,
    "scheduler_policy_code": os.sched_getscheduler(0) if hasattr(os, "sched_getscheduler") else None,
    "priority_changed_by_experiment": False,
    "load_average_before": list(os.getloadavg()) if hasattr(os, "getloadavg") else None,
    "cpu_quota": read_optional(Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max")),
    "cpuset_effective": read_optional(Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective")),
    "memory_limit_bytes_or_max": read_optional(Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max")),
    "one_allowed_cpu_governor": {
        "cpu": first_cpu,
        "value": read_optional(Path(f"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu{first_cpu}/cpufreq/scaling_governor")),
        "scope": "One visible allowed CPU only; not a measured or controlled frequency policy for the run.",
    },
    "power_policy_controlled": False,
    "competing_load": "Uncontrolled shared development container; other agents may compile or analyze concurrently.",
    "compiler": command(["c++", "--version"]),
    "cmake": command(["cmake", "--version"]),
    "lscpu": command(["lscpu", "--json"]),
    "dynamic_dependencies": command(["ldd", str(BINARY)]),
}

cases = [(rate, workload, fmt) for rate in (48000, 192000)
         for workload in ("held", "pedal", "gain") for fmt in (32, 64)]
random.Random(6901).shuffle(cases)
records = []
checks = 0


def verify(value: bool, message: str):
    global checks
    checks += 1
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


start = stamp()
elapsed_start = time.perf_counter()
for index, (rate, workload, fmt) in enumerate(cases):
    argv = [str(BINARY), "--blocks", "300", "--warmup-blocks", "32",
            "--block-size", "64", "--sample-rate", str(rate),
            "--active-keys", "73", "--workload", workload,
            "--sample-format", str(fmt), "--machine", "a069-shared-linux-container"]
    began = stamp()
    result = command(argv)
    ended = stamp()
    stem = SCRATCH / f"{index:02d}-{rate}-{workload}-{fmt}"
    stem.with_suffix(".stdout.json").write_text(result["stdout"])
    stem.with_suffix(".stderr.txt").write_text(result["stderr"])
    verify(result["exit_code"] == 0 and result["stderr"] == "", "Process failure")
    data = json.loads(result["stdout"], parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
        ValueError("Non-finite JSON constant: " + value)))
    verify(data["complete"] is True, "Incomplete benchmark")
    raw = data["timing"]["raw_callback_us"]
    stats = data["timing"]["summary"]
    verify(len(raw) == 300 and all(type(x) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0
                                 for x in raw), "Invalid observations")
    ordered = sorted(raw)
    independent = {
        "observations": len(raw), "mean_us": math.fsum(raw)/len(raw),
        "p50_us": ordered[math.ceil(len(raw)*0.50)-1],
        "p95_us": ordered[math.ceil(len(raw)*0.95)-1],
        "p99_us": ordered[math.ceil(len(raw)*0.99)-1],
        "max_us": max(raw), "deadline_us": 1e6*64/rate,
        "deadline_misses": sum(x > 1e6*64/rate for x in raw),
    }
    for key, value in independent.items():
        verify(math.isclose(stats[key], value, rel_tol=2e-14, abs_tol=0), f"Bad {key}")
    interval = math.ceil(rate/(2*64))
    triggers = len(range(0, 300, interval))
    notes = triggers*73*(2 if workload == "pedal" else 1)
    points = 300*64 if workload != "held" else 0
    owners = 0 if workload == "pedal" else 73
    for key, value in {
        "requested_blocks": 300, "measured_blocks": 300,
        "requested_warmup_blocks": 32, "completed_warmup_blocks": 32,
        "sample_rate_hz": rate, "sample_format_bits": fmt, "block_frames": 64,
        "selected_key_count": 73, "retrigger_interval_blocks": interval,
        "offered_note_events": notes, "offered_parameter_points": points,
    }.items():
        verify(data["workload"][key] == value, f"Bad workload {key}")
    for key, value in {
        "successful_callbacks": 300, "failed_callbacks": 0, "frame_cursor": 19200,
        "active_note_owners": owners, "expected_note_owners": owners,
        "note_getter_reads": notes, "parameter_point_getter_reads": points,
    }.items():
        verify(data["integrity"][key] == value, f"Bad integrity {key}")
    for key in ("warmup_success", "finite_output_and_checksum", "stereo_equal",
                "silence_flags_correct", "nonzero_output_expected", "output_presence_correct"):
        verify(data["integrity"][key] is True, f"False integrity {key}")
    verify(data["integrity"]["nonzero_channel_samples"] > 0, "Absent output")
    records.append({"order": index, "argv": argv, "started_utc": began,
                    "ended_utc": ended, "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
                    "stdout_sha256": hashlib.sha256(result["stdout"].encode()).hexdigest(),
                    "stderr": result["stderr"], "independent_summary": independent,
                    "simulated_measured_duration_s": 300*64/rate,
                    "retriggers_per_selected_key_in_measured_phase": triggers,
                    "observation": data})
    print(f"{index:02d} {rate} {workload} {fmt}: p50={stats['p50_us']:.3f} "
          f"p99={stats['p99_us']:.3f} max={stats['max_us']:.3f} "
          f"misses={stats['deadline_misses']}/300", flush=True)

after = {p: digest(ROOT / p) for p in bound_paths}
verify(before == after, "Bound source/build/archive/binary identity changed during observation")
environment["load_average_after"] = list(os.getloadavg()) if hasattr(os, "getloadavg") else None
payload = {
    "schema_version": 1, "assignment": "development-20261123/A069",
    "scope": "Observed wall-clock cost of the actual synthetic VST3 processor callback; no device or commercial host.",
    "started_utc": start, "ended_utc": stamp(),
    "experiment_elapsed_s": time.perf_counter()-elapsed_start,
    "source_commit": SOURCE_COMMIT, "source_files_match_commit": source_matches,
    "tested_identity_sha256_before": before, "tested_identity_sha256_after": after,
    "tested_identities_unchanged": before == after,
    "sdk_pins": pins,
    "actual_build_files": {p: (ROOT / p).read_text() for p in BUILD_FILES},
    "environment": environment,
    "design": {"measured_callbacks_per_case": 300, "warmup_callbacks_per_case": 32,
